title: Change in surface pH, OceanSODA-ETHZ v2025
source: Fix Planet map from OceanSODA-ETHZ v2025. Colour is the change in surface pH (total scale) from the 1985–1989 mean to the 2020–2024 mean. Boundaries: Natural Earth 1:10m.
license: NOAA NCEI OCADS / OceanSODA-ETHZ. Boundaries public domain (Natural Earth).
note: Negative numbers are a decline in pH. Not a sea-surface temperature map.

title: Dissolved oxygen minimum, 100–1000 m, World Ocean Atlas 2023
source: Fix Planet map from NOAA World Ocean Atlas 2023 dissolved oxygen, annual 1° field, minimum between 100 m and 1000 m, 1965–2022. Boundaries: Natural Earth 1:10m.
license: Public domain (NOAA). Boundaries public domain (Natural Earth).
note: Numeric scale is micromoles per kilogram. No unit words in the image.

title: Sea-ice concentration, NSIDC Sea Ice Index, Arctic March 2026 and Antarctic September 2025
source: Fix Planet map from NSIDC Sea Ice Index G02135 v4 monthly concentration GeoTIFFs. Arctic March 2026 and Antarctic September 2025, polar stereographic.
note: Numeric scale is percent concentration. Land is the NSIDC mask. No place names.

title: Sea-level trend, NOAA Laboratory for Satellite Altimetry, 1992.96–2025.10

note: Numeric scale is millimetres per year. Diverging colours centred on zero.
